identity.one_line: A Fire retaliation tank supported by Hellfire Imps and an Abyssal. Blocks and hits taken fuel rebukes, shields, soul-furnace effects, and pet commands. It offers good AoE threat and active mitigation but has more summon and cooldown management than a simple shield tank.

mechanics.core_loop: A Fire retaliation tank supported by Hellfire Imps and an Abyssal. Blocks and hits taken fuel rebukes, shields, soul-furnace effects, and pet commands. It offers good AoE threat and active mitigation but has more summon and cooldown management than a simple shield tank.

modes.structural_description: Transform: s your Call: Hellfire Imp into Impcaller.Impcaller (Aura)Your Infernal Strike now summons a Hellfire Imp to aid you in combat for 10 seconds, but its Rage cost is increased by 10.In addition, the maximum health of your imps is increased by 30%.
